title: Private Dinner Cooking and Cocktails Class
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Travelers will be able to select a drink tasting menu and dinner menu for their group to sample and participate in creating. Guests will taste the menu and take home samples for later. Cuisine ranges from Mexican to Japanese menus, to reflect the knowledge, experience and culture of the host.
